description: This PHP source file defines the ViewDropdowns class, which manages the display and interaction logic for dropdown management in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It includes methods for rendering dropdown editing UI components, handling AJAX requests, and integrating with other modules like DropDownTree and DropDownBrowser.

classes.name: ViewDropdowns
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that handles rendering the dropdown management interface in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the dropdown management UI, including AJAX sections, dropdown nodes, and images.
